decisions.statement: A subagent nobody stopped states this neither way.
A subagent stopped this way is refused every model turn it asks for after that.
The stop reaches the subagent at the next model turn that subagent asks for.
A subagent inside a tool call finishes that call before the stop reaches it.
A stop written here outlives a restart of the proxy refusing the turns.
A stop outlives that restart only while the page it is beside is there.
A stop written here reads the subagent's page as stale to the sweep.
A stop written here goes with the subagent's page.

definition: whether a subagent was stopped from the agents panel
